verdict.notes: No must_find IDs. Supplier instruction is not recognized; silence is incompleteness, not inferred obedience. External/runtime boundary, factories, lifecycle/reset, full review snapshot lookup, delivery payload and complete host history are incomplete. Two errors: unestablished one-use guarantee violation from fresh authorization; minor exhaustive prune inventory omits count(). Blind-review proposal is qualified under documented displayed snapshot contract, with no local review UI claimed. Tests scoped to plan tests; no execution claimed. Exact served auditor identity unavailable.
unsupported_gap_claims: This breaks the "one-use execution receipt" guarantee and needs only the approver's action. — Fresh approve-authorized review replaces Decision and permits another execution, but each decision remains one-use. Contract explicitly consumes a decision on one execution attempt and does not prohibit fresh authorization of unchanged plan. Asserted guarantee violation is unestablished; policy proposal itself allowed.

Pruning happens only on `open` and `resolve`. — Prune also happens in count(); exhaustive only inventory is incorrect even though reachable public capacity assessment is sound. Minor inventory error, not an invented isolation exploit.
